(def interpose
  "Returns a lazy seq of the elements of coll separated by sep.
  Returns a stateful transducer when no collection is provided."
  (fn
    ([sep]
     (fn [rf]
       (let [started (volatile! false)]
         (fn
           ([] (rf))
           ([result] (rf result))
           ([result input]
            (if @started
              (let [sepr (rf result sep)]
                (if (reduced? sepr)
                  sepr
                  (rf sepr input)))
              (do
                (vreset! started true)
                (rf result input))))))))
    ([sep coll] (drop 1 (interleave (repeat sep) coll)))))
rationale: Expand the complete pinned defn to def/fn, retaining its documentation (#30). Clojure's interpose has the same transducer and sequence arities.
